messages.author: c7a0d087ca7b2eb2
messages.subject: Big data
parts:
I have a great problem, too much data! The chain store prices are my first attempt to deal with high dim of obs, just mega over ~20days have approximately 1.8e11 obs of prices. There are bigger promotion files for each price file and 17 other chains.

All data is in xml format so converting to data.frame is not feasible. Where can this be stored for cheap? Is azure sql my best solution? Is there an efficient way to convert from xml to sql?

messages.author: eb340cf0e0f94e2e
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] Big data
parts:
I would use spark for this, there is also an "rspark" package.

you can set up a relatively cheap cluster based on old PCs (I'm using Raspberry Pi 2).

you can check out this course in edx to see how to use this system:
https://courses.edx.org/courses/BerkeleyX/CS100.1x/1T2015/info
